item.title: BMW recalls nearly 90,000 vehicles over fire risk
item.description: BMW is recalling nearly 90,000 vehicles, including one Toyota model, because of an engine starter defect that could overheat and cause a fire, according to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.

item.title: Pritzker addresses economic hurdles as Chicago Bears stadium battle heats up
item.description: Governor JB Pritzker addressed the ongoing battle to keep the Chicago Bears in Illinois, while highlighting the expansion of the STAR Bond Program, which provides additional financing options for local projects, though not for professional sports stadiums.
